implementation_summary: auditRerunRoutes / createAuditRerunRoutes for AUDIT_API.rerun (owner, beta closed). Checks in order: owner (403), audit exists (404), latest version not running (409 ERR_AUDIT_RUNNING), run slot free (409 ERR_RUN_IN_PROGRESS), address re-check (400/422). Then slot.begin kind audit, store.addVersion, runs.start, then the injectable starter (default runAuditVersion), reply 202 AuditStartReply. A start failure marks the new version failed with AUDIT_START_FAILED, releases the slot and answers 500 with no internals.

risks: Non-owner gets 403 before audit existence is checked
Running is decided from the stored status; a version left running by a crash blocks re-runs
AUDIT_ERROR_CODES has no start-failure code; 500 body is { error } only, version error uses fixed wording AUDIT_START_FAILED
If the store cannot be written when marking a failed start, the version stays running (silent)
Windows EPERM rename when the version file is read during a write; test polls only the slot to avoid it
